EXTRAS NEEDED - WOLVERHAMPTON
We’re looking for men and women aged 18+ who can convincingly play 14–15-year-old students for an upcoming short film about dyspraxia, created to help raise awareness and understanding of the condition.

📍 Wolverhampton Sunday, 11th October
⏰ Needed for approximately 3 hours
💰 Unpaid
🍕 Food & drink provided
🎞 IMDb credit provided

You’ll be appearing as students in classroom and hallway scenes.

If interested, please email williamsonowen2023@gmail.com

Thank you!

Som tak for hjælpen gives udover forplejning et b-honorar på 4500,00 kr. Mærk venligst mailen //Bank//

HASTER: MANDLIG STATIST SØGES TIL AFGANGSFILM - DEN DANSKE FILMSKOLE

Til afgangsfilmen ANGELS, instrueret af Jonatan Egholm Keis og produceret af Astrid Andreasen, søger vi en mandlig statist til at spille en indsat i et fængsel.

Optagelserne foregår i Albertslund nu på fredag d. 9. oktober i tidsrummet 13.30-16.00.

Er det dig? Eller kender du nogen? Så hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Send en mail til statisten.nu@gmail.com med fulde navn, alder, kontaktoplysninger og et vellignende billede.

Skriv: *"Fængsel"* i emnefeltet.

OBS: Kun henvendelser via mail vil blive besvaret.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

***Om filmen***

*ANGELS er en rockerfilm uden læderveste, motorcykler, narko og pistoler. Det er en moderne gangsterfilm til den tid, vi lever i, som fokuserer på mennesket bag den kriminelle etikette.*

Deltagelse er ulønnet, men der vil være forplejning på set.

CASTING CALL — “THE PORTRAIT”
CCA Production 1 Student Short Film

Seeking a male actor for the Photographer.

Preferred playing age: 24–32.

During a portrait session, a photographer and his subject stumble into moments of accidental intimacy. A playful stolen-glasses gag turns their awkward attraction into an intentional connection.

This is a no-dialogue role built around expressive physical acting, comic timing, subtle reactions, and chemistry with the female lead. Blocking will be rehearsed, with room for controlled improvisation.

Shoot dates: November 7–8, 2026
Location: CCA studio, Denver/Aurora area
Commitment: Up to eight hours each shoot day, plus a separate rehearsal scheduled by mutual availability.

Unpaid student production. Lunch and craft services provided.

Director / DP: Jim Burnes
Casting Director / Rehearsal Lead: Mitch Marquez

If interested, please message Jim Burnes with a headshot, reel or recent audition clip if available, and your availability for both shoot days and rehearsal. Script available upon request.

We’re still looking for two actors to help us on October 16 and 17 in Brussels. �So we’re looking for a man and a woman who look to be around 30–32 years old.

If you’re interested, feel free to send me a message. You can also call me anytime at +32 471 03 09 43 or send an email to margodefrancq@gmail.com

Best regards,

Margo Defrancq

🎬 CASTING DO SPOTU REKLAMOWEGO
Pilne!!!

Poszukujemy aktorów/epizodystów:

Kobieta — 18-20 lat

Młoda kobieta o charakterystycznej, naturalnej urodzie i wyrazistej twarzy. Wygląd nastolatki. Długie ciemne włosy, szczupła sylwetka.

Typ: niezależna, współczesna, z charakterem.

Mile widziana naturalna, nieoczywista uroda i mocna osobowość.

Mężczyzna — 65-85 lat

Senior o siwych włosach i zaroście. Szczupła lub średnia sylwetka.

Szukamy osoby ciepłej, wiarygodnej i emocjonalnej, potrafiącej opowiadać historię przede wszystkim spojrzeniem i mimiką.

Naturalność i autentyczność mile widziane.

Mężczyzna — 20-25 lat

Młody, atrakcyjny mężczyzna. Szczupła, proporcjonalna sylwetka.

Typ: miejski, nowoczesny, premium / corporate.

Zadbany, pewny siebie, ambitny.

Zgłoszenia tylko drogą mailową!

📍 Zdjęcia w Warszawie w 2 połowie października

blackwolfproductionpl@gmail.com

• Imię i nazwisko

• Wiek

• Numer telefonu

• Zdjęcie twarzy i całej sylwetki

• Demo/real (link do YouTube)

Pozostałe szczegóły przekażemy wybranym osobom.

items.text:
🎤 **INDYWIDUALNE LEKCJE ŚPIEWU | WARSZAWA**

📍 **Bielany / Młociny – blisko metra Młociny**
💻 Zajęcia **stacjonarnie lub online**

🌿 Więcej o mnie i o tym, jak pracuję, znajdziesz na: **singspiration.pl**

👉 Jeśli chcesz sprawdzić dostępne terminy, wejdź na stronę i kliknij **„Zapisz mnie”** – przejdziesz bezpośrednio do kalendarza, w którym możesz wybrać wolny termin.

🎬 **Drodzy statyści, epizodyści, przyszli aktorzy, hobbyści i pasjonaci aktorstwa!**

Statystowanie i pierwsze epizody mogą być świetnym sposobem, żeby poznać plan filmowy od środka, obserwować pracę aktorów i sprawdzić, czy jest to droga, którą chcemy rozwijać dalej.

Jeśli jednak czujesz, że chcesz zrobić **kolejny krok** – próbować swoich sił w castingach, przygotowywać się do szkoły aktorskiej, teatru, musicalu, dubbingu czy pracy z mikrofonem – warto zacząć świadomie budować swój warsztat.

🎭 **Jednym z podstawowych narzędzi aktora jest głos.**

Lekcje śpiewu nie zastąpią zajęć aktorskich, ale mogą być ich wartościowym uzupełnieniem. Podczas spotkań pracujemy m.in. nad:

• głosem i oddechem
• emocjami i interpretacją
• świadomością ciała i napięć
• ekspresją i obecnością sceniczną
• tremą i blokadami przed występowaniem
• większą swobodą w byciu słyszanym i widzianym

W swojej pracy łączę **4 obszary: EMOCJĘ • MYŚL • CIAŁO • GŁOS**.

Jeśli myślisz o egzaminach do szkoły aktorskiej, warto pamiętać również o przygotowaniu wokalnym – śpiew może być jednym z elementów rekrutacji.

🌿 **Obecnie szukam 5 osób zdecydowanych na regularną pracę i dłuższy proces.**

Pierwsza lekcja jest spotkaniem zapoznawczym – poznajesz mój sposób pracy, a ja Ciebie, Twój głos i Twoje cele. Sprawdzamy, czy dobrze nam się współpracuje.

Jeśli tak, zapraszam do regularnej pracy w formie **karnetu 4 lekcji**

Nie musisz mieć dużego doświadczenia. Zależy mi przede wszystkim na osobach, które **naprawdę chcą się rozwijać i są gotowe dać sobie czas na ten proces.**

🎤 Jestem wokalistką i trenerką wokalną, absolwentką wykonawstwa wokalnego, pedagogiki i arteterapii. Rozwijałam się również aktorsko w ACT Studio, a obecnie studiuję w Warszawskiej Szkole Filmowej.

**Twój głos. Twoja podróż. Twoja przemiana.**

👉 Więcej informacji i zapisy: **singspiration.pl → „Zapisz mnie”**

[Czuła Fundacja](https://www.facebook.com/groups/270036604683336/user/61574737536982/?__cft__[0]=AZg7PwLkVrK1EkNVApZZpKlY3oJkCB84YNuJQkW_98mC8JB9sSfvlXSP3mtlkfbcQzrHfUWh431IB_gDlrWmDt3v81HYk7mGawZ9JCLPsUt3Ue9tIlIXDbyKKJ1Zfy2o2BUssyxihrPJjgM&__tn__=-]K-R) Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie wystartowała!

Są jeszcze ostatnie miejsca w obydwu grupach!

Możesz przyjść na pierwsze zajęcia już dzisiaj! 

Podaruj swojemu dziecku bezpieczną przestrzeń do rozwoju, profesjonalnej edukacji teatralnej i eksploracji wyobraźni!

Spotykamy się we wtorki.

Z dziećmi od 7 do 9 lat - od 16.00 do 17.30.

Z dziećmi od 9 do 12 lat od 17.30 do 19.00.

w FORMA Ośrodek Kultury

Zajęcia Małej Akademii Teatralnej to profesjonalna edukacja teatralna, w poszanowaniu granic uczestników. Na zajęciach dzieci się wygłupiają i szaleją. Mogą zrealizować wszystkie swoje pomysły. Twarzą pełne wsparcia relacje rówieśnicze.

Jeśli chcesz dowiedzieć się więcej o naszych warsztatach artystycznych i twórczej działalności, odwiedź naszą stronę internetową: https://www.czulafundacja.pl/tworcze-przestrzenie

albo stronę FB Centrum Twórcze Przestrzenie.

Hello Subject: Professional Dancer – Job Application. Dear Sir/Madam, My name is Khayal Sadikhov, and I am a professional dancer from Azerbaijan with over 20 years of international stage experience. Throughout my career, I have performed with Cirque Medrano, Anadolu Ateşi, the Azerbaijan State Folk Dance Ensemble, and other international productions. My specialties include Caucasian dance, classical ballet, modern dance, and acrobatic performance. I would be very interested in joining your team and taking part in your upcoming productions and projects. I believe my extensive stage experience and professional background could be a valuable contribution to your company. Please find my CV an performance videos attached for your consideration. Thank you very much for your time. I would be happy to provide any additional information if required. Best regards, Khayal Sadikhov. Gmail: khayalgenje2020@gmail.com

items.summary:
Hello Subject: Professional Dancer – Job Application. Dear Sir/Madam, My name is Khayal Sadikhov, and I am a professional dancer from Azerbaijan with over 20 years of international stage experience. Throughout my career, I have performed with Cirque Medrano, Anadolu Ateşi, the Azerbaijan State Folk Dance Ensemble, and other international productions. My specialties include Caucasian dance, classical ballet, modern dance, and acrobatic performance. I would be very interested in joining your team and taking part in your upcoming productions and projects. I believe my extensive stage experience and professional background could be a valuable contribution to your company. Please find my CV an performance videos attached for your consideration. Thank you very much for your time. I would be happy to provide any additional information if required. Best regards, Khayal Sadikhov. Gmail: khayalgenje2020@gmail.com 
khayalganja2016@gmail.com

ECHO | LONDON OPEN CALL 2026
Group Exhibition
2–5 November 2026
Blank Canvas Gallery, London
Presented by Yune Art
With media support from Harper’s BAZAAR

THEME

ECHO explores what remains after an event, a gesture, a relationship or a generation has passed.

Expectations surrounding family, gender, the body and identity can travel across generations, changing as they move between different people, environments and cultural contexts.

The exhibition considers how emotional residue, cultural memory and inherited experience are transformed through time, migration, material and the body, eventually resurfacing in new and sometimes unexpected forms.

We welcome submissions exploring themes including generational experience, memory, identity, family structures, gender, the body, inheritance, and transformation.

Submissions are particularly encouraged from artists mainly working with glass, textile, sound, sculpture, installation, although other contemporary practices will also be considered.

SELECTED ARTISTS WILL RECEIVE
- Physical exhibition in London
- Media support and exposure through Harper’s BAZAAR
- Opportunities for artwork sales
- Professional exhibition documentation
- International promotional exposure

SUBMISSION DETAILS
Submission Fee: Free
Exhibition Fee: Applicable to selected artists only
Submission Deadline: 26 October 2026
Exhibition Dates: 2–5 November 2026
Venue: Blank Canvas Gallery, London SW6 7EJ

To apply, please submit your portfolio+ artist/work statement to:
yune.art@outlook.com

https://www.instagram.com/yune_art_official?stkn=MTJyODhzYWVvcGhhdA%3D%3D&utm_source=qr

Greetings Actors! Seeking an African American male actor who has singing talent and is comfortable playing a gay role as Franklin. We also have an open role as Stanley, and details for each character are below for our upcoming stage production, which is coming on December 12th and 19th, performing live in both Macon & Atlanta, GA. These are paid roles. Please do not submit if you are not reliable or unable to attend scheduled rehearsals. These are every Tuesday and Thursday via Zoom, 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM, and in person every 1st and 3rd Saturdays from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM. Accepting castings from local Atlanta actors or surrounding cities. Auditions are held via Zoom. Please submit Headshots along with contact info.  

Franklin: Male, age range 27 to 33. Full of life, funny, always has jokes, and sings his heart out. However, he's keeping a secret boyfriend that he thinks no one in the family knows about. Must be comfortable playing a gay role and must be able to sing.

Stanley: Male, age range 25 to 30. Cool, laid-back, friendly guy unlike his sister and mother.  

For submissions: Taraentertainmentllc@gmail.com

𝐖𝐞𝐥𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐀𝐜𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐲:

𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐫𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐚 𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠.

If you have a deep passion for acting and are committed to building a professional career in the performing arts, you have found your ideal training ground. —welcome to 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐀𝐜𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐲, where you turn: “𝐈’𝐝 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐚𝐜𝐭” into “𝐈’𝐦 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐥 𝐜𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐞𝐫.”

Marble Academy is proud to be a Spotlight-accredited drama school and two-time consecutive winner of ‘𝐁𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐃𝐫𝐚𝐦𝐚 𝐒𝐜𝐡𝐨𝐨𝐥 𝐎𝐟 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐘𝐞𝐚𝐫’, reflecting the high calibre of education and training provided here.  Designed to strip away bad habits and build strong, repeatable techniques for TV, Film, and Theatre.

Led directly by Christian Le Feuvre—a LAMDA-qualified actor and award-winning filmmaker—our tailored modules give you the practical skills needed to thrive in a competitive industry and include:

•  𝐒𝐜𝐫𝐢𝐩𝐭 𝐀𝐧𝐚𝐥𝐲𝐬𝐢𝐬 & 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Uncover deep subtext and embody characters authentically.

•  𝐀𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐂𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐚: Master the subtle, intimate nuances required for screen performance.

•  𝐀𝐮𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐏𝐫𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧: Build the technical control and confidence required to walk into any audition room ready to impress.

•  𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧: Mondays, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM

•  𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞: Swinton, Manchester

 Explore Student Testimonials & Reserve Your Audition: [www.marbleacademy.co.uk](https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marbleacademy.co.uk%2F%3Ffbclid%3DIwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgVicmlkETFBQ0hEdEZmUkRtcEZLQ2Nmc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHvxSscPZ2H73UrDPKzBf_uw2gaVbBa_KSwpSljnKhiPrP4RuVhiRF6H1dIN0_aem_Qn_yXlGnqX4jAwp13fy3DA&h=AUA4oX3cHpshD47YrnN_kifrd-sVkqVlrmDBta0pBgB8L-_7E4MKU_ZclKC4CNRsp1pRey55HDTCjKiV9YsWrxDcCfuj1q7PwKyCzNyOIoYcTaXTVk_9s0HLXANyeaISeM77I3pKIA6RfIEsgy3hv14_sDIXGVJk&__tn__=-UK-R&c[0]=AUAtd5LQFhx6MNglCTpTIUPw2pbfLBgmdWS6jfFPMklHYO6TewrKKjW--C5tRb0FsSdxf5n4Z8iY0u5EnqHQ-DNF1oJbS7yaL3fZOvnFbw1LgPg_CykzqBqRoDmebpPmBazE2GJY9XvuioB4AjyDUa2W9BfyMcuKhxiqPaJ845R2FHGc2dXgc-wsPC2lzRkn21vbJiiPbspBj9CQk8pGBxwOIzotyWnfgYAm)

✨ CASTING CALL – CHRISTMAS 2026 | NORTH WALES ✨

After a smashing season last year, once again we invite you to step into the magic this Christmas! We’re casting a variety of performers and actors for Return of the Guardians, an immersive festive adventure at Reindeer Lodge, Leeswood, North Wales.

We’re looking for talented individuals for:
🎭 Interactive scripted & improvised immersive characters (limited positions available)
🎤 Performers for The Magic of Christmas live stage show (dance and/or musical theatre training desirable for actors)
📅 Contract Dates between : 20th November – 24th December 2026 (mainly Thursday to Sunday dates)
🎬 Rehearsals: 16th–19th November (Prestatyn)
📍 Location: Reindeer Lodge, Leeswood, North Wales (near Mold)
✨ Excellent rate of pay

Please note:
🏡 Accommodation is not provided, so this opportunity is best suited to performers who are based in North Wales or can arrange their own accommodation and travel for the contract period.

If you have a passion for creating unforgettable Christmas memories and love engaging with families through immersive storytelling, we’d love to hear from you.
📧 Send your CV and showreel to: reindeerlodgecasting@gmail.com

Come and help us bring the magic of Christmas to life! 🎄❄️

#castingcall #christmascasting #christmasperformance #performerswales #northwales

Hello Actors, my name is Jennifer Roberson & I am a talent agent with The Wayne Agency and the agency headquarters are in Los Angeles.  I am sharing this opportunity again and if you have not already submitted for this, I would encourage you to do so quickly. We are in the process of narrowing down our selections for the    in-person auditions. Below is all of the information. 

The Wayne Agency is expanding their roster & is hosting an open call for actors looking for representation in the Atlanta, South Central/Texas, Los Angeles, Virginia/East and New York markets.  Ages 5 and up.  There is no fee with this reputable open call and no fees attached and there will be no costs if signed.  We are a proud SAG-AFTRA franchised agency governed by SAG-AFTRA rules.  For the audition, please prepare a 30-60 second commercial (that you connect with and can show us your “brand”) and also either a scene or a monologue.  If you select a scene, you may perform a scene from tv/film and please keep it between 2-3 pages. **OR** for a monologue, please perform a piece that is no longer than 1-2 minutes.  If we are interested, we will reach out to you to schedule an in-person audition time in the Denver area between October 30th-November 1st.  Please submit the Google form below.  If you do NOT have a GMAIL account, please send everything listed on the Google form to the email address: [twashowcase@gmail.com](mailto:twashowcase@gmail.com).  If you have a question, please ask it here. And please check out our website: [https://www.thewayneagency.com/](https://urldefense.proofpoint.com/v2/url?u=https-3A__www.thewayneagency.com_&d=DwMFaQ&c=euGZstcaTDllvimEN8b7jXrwqOf-v5A_CdpgnVfiiMM&r=o8JSr2h6ujNaDfELoLPC65IJVNeuU24Z4w1rP9idmLE&m=FdJWRu-Lu0jmEpoXGZU5JTg6gievjZQr9R7oYXoApBVoIaqJpebQR3JX897EmLzD&s=io2WPYSjpcbjWTnt_Ic1cOeHsmZOO2EV16b429WqH8o&e=)

CASTING CALL FOR SHORT FILM SHOOTING OCTOBER 12TH!!

Title: Kneel

Genre: Horror/Comedy

Logline: A goth girl commands a procession of strangers to kneel before her.

Roles:

Salem (female, 20-30) A mysterious and unnervingly confident woman who doesn't behave like someone walking into danger. She is the danger that has arrived. Must be comfortable wearing dark stylized makeup and wardrobe (black lipstick, dramatic eye makeup, black lace, gothic accessories, black thorn crown, etc) Makeup provided on set. We will source accessories/wardrobe items if needed.

Men (male, 20-30) Several male actors to portray men dressed in suits who emerge from the shadows and kneel before Salem.

Production Type: Indie

Production Company: Loste Films

Contact Information: luke@lostefilms.com

Compensation: Paid

Audition Information: Send an email with headshot, resume and reel. 

Shooting Schedule: October 12th evening/night

Filming Location: Downtown Denver

Project Description: Kneel is a short-form horror/comedy skit being produced as promotional social media content for a local Denver nightclub. This is a fun highly visual project intended to feel like a mini horror film.

CAST & CREW CALL: INDIE HORROR POC (ADDITIONAL SCENES & EDITING)
Project Type: Short Horror / Proof of Concept (POC)

Compensation: In-Kind / Unpaid Passion Project (Meals, stills & footage for reels, IMDb credit, festival entry)

Location: Colorado Springs, CO

Shoot Dates: October 26th, 2026 (Additional dates TBD)

About the Project

We have cut a 10-minute short horror film for the Fresh Meat competition 2027. Now, we are expanding our Proof of Concept (POC) and shooting several additional scenes. We are looking for passionate, creative collaborators to join our Auteure Films production of SuperNova.

Logline: A 23-year-old woman, who suspects she’s losing her mind, attends a support group for young adults diagnosed with a rare illness and finds that they all share a curious history.

CASTING CALL (Additional Roles)

Leo / 25-45/ Male: Tall, big, burly biker type. Looks intimidating but has a heart of gold.

Heather / 25-45 / Female: An aging cheerleader type. Protective, positive, and deeply supportive of others.

SusieQ / 25-45/ Female: A Barbie-like persona. Enthusiastic and sadly sweet, SusieQ brings hope to the group.

Remington ‘Remi’ / 25-45/ Male: Elegantly dressed with a French accent. A sophisticated companion whose goal is to protect and incite joy.

Doctor / 30-45/ Male: Tall, clean-cut professional in scrubs. A supportive friend who is bewildered by the circumstances.

Paramedic Assistant / 25+/ Open Gender: Accompanies the lead paramedic to a crime scene.

Commitment for Cast: Currently one day, evening of Monday, October 26th. Additional shoots tbd.

CREW CALL (Additional)

Camera Operator: Experienced with cinematic framing, dramatic lighting setups, and capturing fluid horror/suspense shots.

Production Sound Mixer / Recordist: Experienced with capturing clean dialogue and building atmospheric tension on set. 

General Production Assistant (PA): General on-set support including assisting the Producer and with craft services, managing props, and assisting talent/crew as needed.

POST-PRODUCTION: HORROR FILM EDITOR

The Role: An experienced video editor who understands the pacing, tension, jump-scares, and rhythm specific to horror and suspense.

The Task: Collaborating with our Directors, DP, and Supervising Editor to piece together past dailies, additional scenes, and music into an integrated, polished 30-to-40-minute POC film.

Requirements: Previous experience editing indie short films or horror projects. Remote flexibility.

How to Apply

Role/Position Applied For- [Your Name]

Your full name, phone number, and the specific role you are applying for.

CAST: Attach your headshot, acting resume, and a link to your reel/monologue.

CREW: Attach your production resume and a link to your website/portfolio (if applicable).

EDITOR: Include your portfolio/reel link, phone number, and your general availability for the month of November.

Note: Cast & Crew applicants must have open availability on October 26th from 3:00 PM to 9:00 PM in the Colorado Springs area.

items.text:
Hello! 

We are casting for another tourism video filmed out in Kamloops. We are looking for an adventurous couple, approximately 45–60 years old, who have a natural ease, playfulness and convincing chemistry together. We would love to see a couple that can spark off each other, and are able to tease each other in a light hearted way, without taking themselves seriously. 

We’re looking for people who feel:

* Warm, curious, and naturally engaging

* Ready for adventure and enjoy an active lifestyle

* Curious about travel and the people they meet

* Comfortable hiking recreationally

* Relaxed and natural on camera

* One member of the couple must be comfortable driving with a full drivers license 

* Will need a standard American accent

The short video follows a couple through a series of experiences - hiking, biking, wineries, and restaurants. The idea is to showcase that this region has something to offer for everyone; both the adventure seekers and the chill outers. The couple will be reading reviews of the spots as they go along, and find themselves getting curious about what they might discover. 

Details:
- 3 days w/c 19th October
- Day rate range $700-$1000 depending on experience
- Kamloops area, must be able to drive to location

If interested, please complete below submission and email georgia@weareskeletoncrew.ca

**SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS **

For this project, the client is looking for a couple submission only. 

We would love to see you both in frame, side by side, framed from the top of the head to just above chest. 

Please submit:
* Slate
* Scene 1
* Scene 2

**On your slate we would love to see:**
* Name, height, location, union status

**Scene 1**

Describe your last adventure weekend. Where would you go, what activities would you do? What roles did you both play on the trip? Does one of you do the planning, how do you compromise? 

**Scene 2**

Find an online review for any location, coffee shop, restaurant, and read it allowed to your partner. Discuss between you what you think it’ll be like, and you decide to give it a go!

🎬 CASTING CALL — THE NEIGHBOUR

We are currently casting for our upcoming short film **THE NEIGHBOUR**, a psychological drama about a reclusive woman whose carefully hidden past is disrupted when a young girl from next door discovers her secret.

🎭 **ROLES:**

**GRETCHEN - Female, 60s**
A reclusive woman who has spent decades disappearing from the world. After a troubled childhood and a life built around staying unseen, a young girl begins to break through her walls.

**PIXIE - Any Gender, 10–14**
A sharp, observant kid who acts like she has everything figured out. Behind her tough exterior, she is simply looking for someone to step in and protect her.

**ANNIE - Female, 30s**
Pixie’s mother. Exhausted and overwhelmed by life, Annie keeps going because she feels she has no choice. Beneath her sharp edges, she deeply loves her daughter.

**DERIC - Male, 30s**
Pixie’s father. Volatile and desperate, he is convinced he has been wronged. The role requires an actor who can shift from threatening to shaken within a single scene.

📍 **Shooting Location:** Greater Vancouver Area
🎥 **Shooting Dates:** November 20–22, 2026
📅 **Call Backs:** October 22, 2026
📍 **Call Back Location:** 142 Water Street, VFS Film Production

**Union & Non-Union welcome.**
Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Canada.

📩 **HOW TO APPLY**
Please send your **Resume, Headshot, and Demo Reel (if applicable)** to:

**[theneighbour.production@outlook.com](mailto:theneighbour.production@outlook.com)**

Please include the **role you would like to be considered for**.

🗓️ **Deadline: October 15, 2026**

Shortlisted applicants will receive **self-tape instructions**.

If you know an actor who would be a great fit, please **share this post or tag them below!** 🎬

🎬 **CASTING CALL — FEMALE LEAD PUNJABI SPEAKING**
Volunteer Opportunity | SoulTales Creative

Seeking a South Asian actress with a playing age of 30–35 to play Avneet in our indie Punjabi short film, *Bhanji - Sabotage*.

Avneet is tired of dating but still hopeful about finding love. When someone she connects with suddenly goes quiet, her doubts resurface. The role calls for natural acting that captures vulnerability, hope and anxiety.

Prior acting or on-camera experience is strongly preferred. We’re looking for a committed performer who can dedicate time to character preparation before the shoot. items.text:
🎬 **CASTING CALL — ACTOR WANTED**

I'm looking for a **male actor aged 45–60** to play **MARK**, a parole officer, in a short dramatic project titled **“Dean vs Dean.”**

🎭 **THE ROLE — MARK**

Mark is an experienced parole officer with around **20 years in the prison system**.

After years of seeing prisoners released and sometimes return to prison, Mark has become somewhat weathered and disillusioned with the system. However, he still believes strongly that people can change.

He sees genuine progress in Dean and believes he deserves the opportunity to prove himself outside prison.

Mark is experienced, pragmatic and quietly optimistic. He isn't naive about Dean's behaviour, but he believes that **Dean is moving in the right direction**.

🎭 **THE PERFORMANCE**

This is a **subtle, naturalistic role** built around dialogue and subtext.

Mark and Caroline have fundamentally different views about Dean's future. What begins as a professional discussion gradually develops into a restrained disagreement.

There is **no shouting or melodrama**. The tension comes through tone, pauses, looks, understatement and small changes in behaviour.

Mark should feel like someone who has spent 20 years doing this job. He has confidence in his judgement and doesn't feel the need to prove himself.

As Caroline challenges his assessment, his frustration gradually becomes more apparent. Even at the most tense moments, Mark remains controlled and professional.

The role would suit an actor who enjoys **quiet, character-driven performances where what isn't said is just as important as what is said. (Basically anyone who has experience passive workplace arguments) **
🎬 CASTING

**Role:** Mark
**Gender:** Male
**Age:** 45–60
**Experience:** Professional or experienced amateur actors welcome
**Style:** Naturalistic / dramatic / understated

📅 **Shoot date:** December
📍 **Location:** Canada Water, London
💰 **Payment:** Unpaid

If you're interested, please drop a comment or **send me a DM with a headshot and showreel if available**, along with a little information about yourself and your acting experience.

Thanks!

📢 **CASTING CALL: NEW MUSICAL** 📢

Clapping Productions are looking for talented performers excited to originate a character and help bring a brand-new musical to the stage.

 

**LITTLE WHITE FEATHERS** is an exciting new musical about love, loss, family-ties, and the belief that our deceased loved ones may still be with us. With 17 original songs, this brand-new musical is filled with mystery, humour, heart, and hope.

 

💰 **THIS IS A PROFIT-SHARE PRODUCTION**
📍 **VENUE:** Hope Street Theatre, Liverpool
📅 **PLAYING DATES:** 6th, 7th & 8th May 2027
🎭 **REHEARSALS:** Liverpool
🚗 **EXPENSES PAID:** Petrol and bus fares. Light refreshments supplied throughout rehearsals and performances.

 

**SHOW WILL BE VIDEOED - A SHOWREEL WILL BE GIVEN TO EACH PERFORMER**

👥 **ROLES AVAILABLE:**

 
* **MAGGIE MAGUIRE** — Female, 55 (Irish | Feisty | Salt of the earth | Highly emotional)
A warm-hearted, passionate, and determined Irish woman who wears her heart on her sleeve.
* **JACK MAGUIRE** — Male, 55 (Scouser | Jovial | Funny | Lovable)
Maggie's devoted husband. A cheeky-chappie with a great sense of humour.
* **PSYCHIC SID** — Male, 40–65 (Dramatic | Flamboyant | Theatrical)

* **EMMY BRIGHT** — Female, 26 (South American | Vivacious | Cute | Confident)
A vibrant, charismatic young woman with energy and personality. Confident and engaging.
* **JUDE TAYLOR** — Male, 28 (Posh | Shy | Geeky)
Intelligent, slightly awkward, and endearingly shy.

📧 **HOW TO APPLY:**
To apply for a role, please send your CV, Showreel, or Self-Tape to:
👉 **[info@clappingproductions.com](mailto:info@clappingproductions.com)**

Er du ægte Annika fan? Så er det måske lige noget for dig 👀

Vi er i gang med at caste til et nyt sjovt koncept, hvor 6 ægte Annika fans skal dyste mod 1 bedrager, som skal forsøge at bluffe sig til at være fan af Annika.

Gennem forskellige runder skal I snakke om Annika, hendes musik, sange, koncerter og jeres oplevelser som fans, mens I samtidig skal prøve at gennemskue, hvem der ikke er den ægte fan.

Det foregår i København NV, og der er 1.000 kr. på spil. Hvis bedrageren bliver afsløret, deler de ægte fans præmien. Hvis bedrageren slipper igennem, vinder personen hele beløbet.

Kender du en ægte Annika fan, som kunne være med? Så tag gerne personen her eller send opslaget videre.

Læs mere og tilmeld dig her:
[https://contentcasting.dk/castings/75689658-2031-4efe-bef3-913dcc9a1dde](https://contentcasting.dk/castings/75689658-2031-4efe-bef3-913dcc9a1dde)

**Håndmodel søges til lønnede Arla-optagelser den 7. og 8. oktober**

På vegne af Arla, The Barn, søger jeg en håndmodel til vores kommende optagelser. Vi søger en person med hænder og kropsbygning, der ligner personen på de vedhæftede referencebilleder - gerne med en let solbrun hudtone og uden synlige tatoveringer på hænder, arme og overkrop.

Optagelserne foregår i Viby J, Aarhus, og det er en fordel, hvis du bor i Aarhus eller omegn. På optagelserne vil du være iført sportstøj, og kun hænder og overkrop vil være synlige, uden ansigt eller andre genkendelige kendetegn. Jobbet er lønnet, og vi ønsker en aftale med total buyout af rettighederne til materialet.

Er du interesseret og tilgængelig på de nævnte datoer, så send mig gerne en mail med billeder af dine hænder og dig selv samt en kort beskrivelse af dig.

Mail: [ext_cecch@arlafoods.com](mailto:ext_cecch@arlafoods.com)
Bemærk, at vi kun kontakter de kandidater, der matcher det, vi søger.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Casting für junge Künstler:

Dinnershow im Krönum

**Du bist ein talentierter Künstler und möchtest deine Fähigkeiten in einer einzigartigen Dinnershow präsentieren? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!**

 

Wir suchen junge, kreative Künstler aus den Bereichen Akrobatik, Tanz, Musik, Comedy und mehr, die Lust haben, bei einer exklusiven Dinnershow im Krönum mitzumachen. Du kannst dich auch gerne als Duo bewerben!

 

So kannst du dich bewerben:

 

-   Schick uns ein kurzes Video (max. 3 Minuten) von deinem Auftritt oder einer Performance, die du vor kurzem durchgeführt hast. Zeige uns deine Fähigkeiten und deine Leidenschaft für die Bühne!

-   Wir treffen eine Vorauswahl und laden die ausgewählten Künstler zu einem persönlichen Casting ein, das am 01.10. stattfinden wird. In absoluten Ausnahmefällen ist auch ein anderer Termin auf Anfrage möglich.

 

Warum teilnehmen?

-   Du erhältst die Chance, Teil einer einzigartigen Dinnershow im Krönum zu werden.

-   ﻿Die Shows beginnen im März und enden im Dezember. Gespielt wird an den Wochenenden und in den sächsischen Ferien. Details folgen.

-   ﻿﻿Es warten spannende Auftrittsmöglichkeiten und ein kreatives Team auf dich.

-   Du kannst dich vor einem begeisterten Publikum präsentieren.

 

Bewerbung:

Sende dein Video inkl. Bilder, sowie eine kurze Beschreibung deiner Person bis spätestens 30.09.2026 an [kulti@turisede.de](mailto:kulti@turisede.de).

Infos zum bereits laufenden Krönum: [https://www.turisede.com/kroenum.html](https://www.turisede.com/kroenum.html)

 

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und vielleicht bald gemeinsam auf der Bühne im Krönum zu stehen!

📸 Models für ein Fahrradhelmshooting in München gesucht!
Du hast bereits Shootingerfahrungen gesammelt und nächste Woche Zeit? Dann melde dich bei uns! 🙌

Bei Alphatrail entwickeln wir hochwertige Fahrradhelme und Zubehör. Jetzt fotografieren wir unsere brandneuen Premiumfahrradhelme in München.

Wir stecken viel Leidenschaft in unsere Produkte. Diese Leidenschaft bringen wir auch ins Shooting ein, mit Liebe zum Detail und dem Anspruch, gemeinsam hochwertige Bilder zu schaffen.

Dafür suchen wir eine männliche und eine weibliche Person aus dem Raum München, die offen und zuverlässig sind und optisch etwa 25 bis 35 Jahre alt wirken. Entscheidend ist der passende Look, nicht dein tatsächliches Alter.

Bin ich geeignet?

✅ Shootingerfahrungen

✅ Leidenschaftlicher Fahrradfahrer

✅ Teamplayer

📍 Ort: München

📅 Zeitraum: Mittwoch, 14.10., bis Samstag, 17.10.2026, konkrete Einsatzzeiten nach Absprache

💶 Vergütung: nach vorheriger Vereinbarung

✨ Auch Personen ohne eigenes Gewerbe sind willkommen!

👉 Interesse? Schreib mir direkt eine private Nachricht mit zwei bis drei aktuellen Fotos, einer kurzen Info zu deiner Shootingerfahrung und deiner Verfügbarkeit.

Du kennst jemanden, der passen könnte? Teile den Beitrag gerne weiter! 😊

CASTING CALL — FEATURE FILM | SHOOTING IN CHINA
Filming planned to start November 2026.

Looking for Pan-Asian actors currently based outside China. International flights to China are covered by production as well as all other costs .MUST SPEAK CHINESE. Payment negotiable.

We are especially looking for TALENT AGENTS / AGENCIES who can provide suitable options. Agent commissions are available.

ROLES

* Zhou Yanyang — Male, 18–22 | 19 shooting days

    Student. Wears glasses. Intelligent appearance, but timid, insecure and jealous.

* Jan Bequelin — Male, 18–22 | 32 shooting days

    Student. Aggressive, unpleasant personality; a bully who intimidates weaker people.

* Chen Jia Yi — Female, 18–22 | 18 shooting days

    Student. Wild, outgoing, comfortable around boys; vain and eager to escape her fishing-village background.

* Avin — Male, 30–40 | 9 shooting days

    Local fixer/troublemaker. Flexible, impulsive and strongly motivated by money.

* Old Quarter — Male, 50–60 | 6 shooting days

    School security guard. Street-smart, slick and prone to bullying outsiders.

* Huang Yan — Female, 40–50 | 15 shooting days

    Fisherwoman and mother. Quiet, hardworking and superstitious; initially timid but capable of great courage when protecting her daughter.

The project is a Chinese theatrical feature combining folk-horror and mystery elements. 电影《鱼猎》项目书.pdf

TO APPLY: Send photos + acting CV + acting/showreel video +  to kustom1234@hotmail.com or via Messenger.

AGENTS: Please send multiple suitable talent options. Commission available if chosen

🎬 CASTING CALL!
Hi! I’m Fé from Just Russel 👋

Just Russel is a Belgian brand that creates personalised food for dogs and cats. 🐶🐱

We’re currently looking for new faces in Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany and France who enjoy being in front of the camera.

For our videos, we’re looking for people who feel comfortable on camera and enjoy creating fun, natural content.

You don’t need to have a pet yourself, we can provide one for the shoot. 😉 But if you do have a four-legged friend who also enjoys being in front of the camera, they’re more than welcome to join!

The most important thing is that you feel comfortable on camera and with an animal by your side on set.

Would you like to be part of our content?

Just fill in the form and who knows, maybe we’ll see you on set soon! 🎥

• Shoot length: Approximately 1 hour
• Pay: $200 per child
• Location and schedule: Flexible
• Timing: Must film before October 12

A parent or guardian for must be present during filming.

Interested parents or guardians, please send me a private message with both children’s ages, recent photos, your general location, and availability.

Production company: Mile High Films

**Compensation:** Actors will be compensated. Lead roles: $150/day. Minor roles: $50/day. Actors will also receive film credit, meals and crafty on set, footage for demo reels, and a digital copy of the final film.

**See attached for Roles and more information.**

Hi All,

 OPEN CASTING CALL - Short Film, *'The Aviary'*.

*The Aviary* is a short drama following 17-year-old 'Úna' and her younger brother 'Aodh'. It follows them as they learn to live with their aunt, Aoife, after their mother's passing.

Filming will take place over one week in late January to early February.

The character of 'Aodh' is a supporting role.

We are accepting applicants based in Ireland.

Young boys aged 9-13 years old.

No acting experience required.

This is an unpaid role. However, transport and meals will be covered during filming.

Please review the poster below, and if interested, submit the required information to the email listed before the closing date, October 26th.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Got a kid who lives and breathes sports, but is stuck on one tricky element? A new CBC Kids series is pairing passionate young athletes with elite coaches to help them hone their skills.

To be eligible, you must: 
👉 Be aged 7-10 years old as of November 1, 2026
👉 Be based in Ontario, Canada 
👉 A parent and the kid applying must be available for 1 ½  days of filming between October 2026 - January 2027.

We encourage kids of all backgrounds & levels of sport to apply (house league, school team, select, etc.)

For more information and to apply, visit: https://www.fortecasting.com/ 

Applications are due on Tuesday, October 20th at 11:59pm and must be submitted by a parent/guardian. ⚽ 🏒 🏀 ⛳ 🎾

#casting #Toronto #YouthSports #tvcasting

Casting for the "Ottersghoul Halloween Spooktacular" at Otterspool Adventure. Liverpool. 

**Event Details:**
*   **Dates:** 24th - 31st October 2026 (All applicants MUST be available for all performance dates)
*   **Guide Times:** 10:00 am - 5:00 pm
*   **Rate:** £100 per day, plus 3 paid rehearsal days potentially next week. 

We do not offer additional expenses for travel or accommodation.

We are casting the following roles:

**Jack Skellington (1 x Dancer/Performer)**
*   **Requirements:** Any gender, minimum height 5'10", tall, slim build.
*   **Brief:** While not strictly a "dance" role, Jack is highly physically articulated. The performer must be able to portray his distinct characteristics through movement. No live dialogue is required (the costume includes a mask and all dialogue will be pre-recorded).

**Sally (1 x Singer/Actor)**
*   **Requirements:** Female identifying.
*   **Brief:** Strong pop vocals with the ability to perform in character and sing as part of a cast. Must be able to pick up choreography and movement, and possess strong character acting skills.

**How to Apply:**
Please ask interested performers to send a recent headshot/photo, along with their showreel or Spotlight links (a vocal reel or vocal performance link is required for Sally applicants), to adam@ajdance.co.uk.

Please ensure they use the subject line: **Halloween Casting**.
**Deadline to apply:** 10th October 2026.

🎬 XTREME — LOOKING FOR A DP / CINEMATOGRAPHER

I’m currently putting together the production team for my independent film XTREME, and I’m looking for a serious DP/Cinematographer in the Tampa/Wesley Chapel area.

This is a narrative film, and I’m looking for someone who understands visual storytelling, camera composition, lighting, movement, and creating a cinematic look.

This is an independent production, so I’m looking for someone who genuinely wants to create something strong and build with a team.

If you're interested, please DM me with:

• Your reel/portfolio
• Your experience
• What camera/equipment you normally work with
• Your availability
• Your location

Serious filmmakers only. 🎥

We’re building an actual production team, not just a group chat.

Wir suchen Märchenfiguren für den Wintermärchenmarkt Erding 2027!

Vom 6. bis 10. Januar 2027 verwandelt sich Erding wieder in ein Märchenland, und wir brauchen euch dafür.

Ob Hexe, König, Zauberer, Fee, Ritter, Zwerg oder eine andere Märchenfigur. Wer Lust hat, Kinder und Familien zu verzaubern, ist herzlich willkommen.

Freude am Mitmachen und ein Kostüm (oder eine Idee dafür). Keine Erfahrung nötig!

Was wir euch bieten:
Als Dankeschön für euren Einsatz bekommt ihr 25 Kästen Bier (150 Liter) geschenkt. Für eure nächste Vereinsfeier, euren Grillabend oder einfach für euch. Das Bier gehört euch, komplett und zum Mitnehmen!

Einfach hier kommentieren oder uns direkt schreiben. Wir freuen uns auf euch!

Wintermärchenmarkt Erding | 6. bis 10. Januar 2027 | Eintritt frei

---

So ist klar: Das Bier gibt es als Geschenk zum Mitnehmen, nicht als Freigetränk auf dem Markt.

📸 Models für ein Fahrradhelmshooting in München gesucht!
Du hast bereits Shootingerfahrungen gesammelt und nächste Woche Zeit? Dann melde dich bei uns! 🙌

Bei Alphatrail entwickeln wir hochwertige Fahrradhelme und Zubehör. Jetzt fotografieren wir unsere brandneuen Premiumfahrradhelme in München.

Wir stecken viel Leidenschaft in unsere Produkte. Diese Leidenschaft bringen wir auch ins Shooting ein, mit Liebe zum Detail und dem Anspruch, gemeinsam hochwertige Bilder zu schaffen.

Dafür suchen wir eine männliche und eine weibliche Person aus dem Raum München, die offen und zuverlässig sind und optisch etwa 25 bis 35 Jahre alt wirken. Entscheidend ist der passende Look, nicht dein tatsächliches Alter.

Bin ich geeignet?

✅ Shootingerfahrungen

✅ Leidenschaftlicher Fahrradfahrer

✅ Teamplayer

📍 Ort: München

📅 Zeitraum: Mittwoch, 14.10., bis Samstag, 17.10.2026, konkrete Einsatzzeiten nach Absprache

💶 Vergütung: nach vorheriger Vereinbarung

✨ Auch Personen ohne eigenes Gewerbe sind willkommen!

👉 Interesse? Schreib mir direkt eine private Nachricht mit zwei bis drei aktuellen Fotos, einer kurzen Info zu deiner Shootingerfahrung und deiner Verfügbarkeit.

Du kennst jemanden, der passen könnte? Teile den Beitrag gerne weiter! 😊

#ModelsGesucht #ShootingMünchen #ModelCasting #Alphatrail #Fahrradhelm

🎭 **Warszawa i Kielce szukają Kelly!**

Teatr Ochoty szuka **aktorki w wieku 18–25 lat** do roli tytułowej w spektaklu **„Kelly // Kelly kontra Big Tech”** w reżyserii Justyny Sobczyk.

🎬 **Wykształcenie aktorskie nie jest wymagane**, ale potrzebne jest doświadczenie sceniczne.

📍 Prace nad spektaklem będą odbywać się przede wszystkim w **Teatrze im. Stefana Żeromskiego w Kielcach**, od **12 stycznia do 13 marca 2027**. Powstaną dwie autonomiczne części spektaklu – warszawska i kielecka – a Kelly pozostanie tą samą osobą w obu.

**Co trzeba wysłać?**
• CV
• krótką informację o doświadczeniu artystycznym lub portfolio
• krótkie nagranie castingowe (ok. 1,5 min), w którym jesteś Kelly podczas streamu
• kilka słów o tym, co interesuje Cię w temacie spektaklu

Nie szukamy gotowej interpretacji postaci – chcemy zobaczyć, jak ją badasz. Telefon w zupełności wystarczy.

📅 **Zgłoszenia do 27.10 do końca dnia**

👉 **FORMULARZ:** [https://forms.gle/xUH9CjW3i3XmzXmm7](https://forms.gle/xUH9CjW3i3XmzXmm7)

II etap odbędzie się **1, 2 lub 3 grudnia w Teatrze Ochoty w Warszawie** i będzie miał formę stacjonarnych warsztatów.

Jeśli znacie kogoś, kto może być Kelly — **podeślijcie dalej!**

https://fb.me/e/27YWzljsdz 🟢

Hong Kong’s acclaimed film of the year, 《We’re Nothing At All（我們不是什麼）》will arrive in Los Angeles in October. Director Herman Yau (邱禮濤導演), along with lead actors AK (江𤒹生) from the Hong Kong group Mirror ，and Ansonbean (陳毅燊), will hold three screening and Q&A events in Los Angeles on October 7, 9, and 10. 

Everyone is welcome to register and purchase tickets to attend.

*Please check the official website of the organizer, Blacklight Global Entertainment, for ticket details:

https://www.blacklight-global.com

Official Instagram:

https://www.instagram.com/blacklightglobal.usa?stkn=MXQ3cXZiazV2MWNuaw==

Hong Kong’s acclaimed film of the year, 《We’re Nothing At All（我們不是什麼）》will arrive in Los Angeles in October. Director Herman Yau (邱禮濤導演), along with lead actors AK (江𤒹生) from the Hong Kong group Mirror ，and Ansonbean (陳毅燊), will hold three screening and Q&A events in Los Angeles on October 7, 9, and 10. 

Everyone is welcome to register and purchase tickets to attend.

*Please check the official website of the organizer, Blacklight Global Entertainment, for ticket details:

https://www.blacklight-global.com

Official Instagram:

https://www.instagram.com/blacklightglobal.usa?stkn=MXQ3cXZiazV2MWNuaw==

———————————

You are welcome to register and purchase tickets to participate.

 • October 7 at USC – Free registration：

https://cinema.usc.edu/events/event.cfm?id=73397

 • October 9 at UCLA – Free registration：

https://www.international.ucla.edu/ccs/event/17766

——————————

 • October 10 public screening at The Culver Theater – Tickets available for purchase：

https://web.theculvertheater.com/films/Were-Nothing-At-All/HO00000747

——————————————

Media inquiries: 

info@blacklight-global.com

items.text:
CASTING animateur.rice et monteur.euse
CASTING animateur.rice graphique et monteur.teuse dans le cadre d’un projet sérieux sur les réseaux ! 

Bonjour ! 

Je suis à la recherche d’un.e animateur.rice/animateur.rice, idéalement sur Angers ou alentours, pour un projet qui me tient particulièrement à cœur. 

J’ai eu, il y a quelques mois maintenant, en discutant avec une amie du fait que je sais modifier ma voix et créer des personnages dans ma tête. Et l’idée m’est venue spontanément : 

« On voit énormément de tutoriels sur internet… mais beaucoup moins de parodies de tutoriels » 

Et c’est ainsi que Mr. Bob prit vie. 

Qui est Mr. Bob ? 

Mr. Bob est un personnage que j’ai créé. Il a l’apparence d’un garçon d’environ 14-15 ans, mais son âge réel reste inconnu. 

Il aime faire des vidéos, mais surtout, il adore faire rire les gens. 

Son idée ? Se lancer sur TikTok et YouTube avec des tutoriels complètement absurdes, maladroits et volontairement nuls. 

🎭🎨 Ce que j’aimerais créer 

L’objectif serait de donner vie à Mr. Bob, sous forme de personnage animé, et de créer progressivement une véritable chaîne autour de lui. 

Je recherche donc quelqu’un capable de : 

* Dessiner et développer graphiquement Mr. Bob.

* Créer différentes poses et expressions du personnage. 

* L’animer. 

* Participer au montage des vidéos. 

* Et surtout, avoir envie de construire cet univers et ce personnage avec moi. 

J’ai déjà une première idée précise de son apparence, ainsi qu’un croquis réalisé par une amie, que je pourrais transmettre. 

🎙️🎬 De mon coté

Je m’occupe du concept, de l’écriture et de la voix du personnage. 

Je fais actuellement ma 3ème année de théâtre (dans une troupe), et je travaille également différentes voix et interprétations, depuis quelques années maintenant. 

L’idée n’est donc pas simplement de créer quelques dessins, mais de construire ensemble un personnage et un projet qui puisse évoluer dans le temps. 

💰Concernant la rémunération

Je préfère être totalement transparente là-dessus. 

Pour le moment, le projet étant encore au tout début de sa création, et commençant seulement à travailler, je n’ai malheureusement pas encore le budget nécessaire pour rémunérer une personne. 

L’objectif est cependant de faire évoluer progressivement le projet et, ainsi, rémunérer la/les personne.s participant au  projet lorsque la chaîne commencera à fonctionner.

Je cherche donc avant tout, pour cette première étape, quelqu’un qui aurait réellement envie de participer à la construction de Mr. Bob et son univers avec moi. 

Si tu es illustrateur.rice, animateur.rice, monteur.euse, ou même simplement quelqu’un qui pense pouvoir apporter quelque chose au projet, malgré cette contrainte de rémunération, n’hésite pas à me contacter en privé !

items.summary:
CASTING animateur.rice et monteur.euse
CASTING animateur.rice graphique et monteur.teuse dans le cadre d’un projet sérieux sur les réseaux ! 

Bonjour ! 

Je suis à la recherche d’un.e animateur.rice/animateur.rice, idéalement sur Angers ou alentours, pour un projet qui me tient particulièrement à cœur. 

J’ai eu, il y a quelques mois maintenant, en discutant avec une amie du fait que je sais modifier ma voix et créer des personnages dans ma tête. Et l’idée m’est venue spontanément : 

« On voit énormément de tutoriels sur internet… mais beaucoup moins de parodies de tutoriels » 

Et c’est ainsi que Mr. Bob prit vie. 

Qui est Mr. Bob ? 

Mr. Bob est un personnage que j’ai créé. Il a l’apparence d’un garçon d’environ 14-15 ans, mais son âge réel reste inconnu. 

Il aime faire des vidéos, mais surtout, il adore faire rire les gens. 

Son idée ? Se lancer sur TikTok et YouTube avec des tutoriels complètement absurdes, maladroits et volontairement nuls. 

🎭🎨 Ce que j’aimerais créer 

L’objectif serait de donner vie à Mr. Bob, sous forme de personnage animé, et de créer progressivement une véritable chaîne autour de lui. 

Je recherche donc quelqu’un capable de : 

* Dessiner et développer graphiquement Mr. Bob.

* Créer différentes poses et expressions du personnage. 

* L’animer. 

* Participer au montage des vidéos. 

* Et surtout, avoir envie de construire cet univers et ce personnage avec moi. 

J’ai déjà une première idée précise de son apparence, ainsi qu’un croquis réalisé par une amie, que je pourrais transmettre. 

🎙️🎬 De mon coté

Je m’occupe du concept, de l’écriture et de la voix du personnage. 

Je fais actuellement ma 3ème année de théâtre (dans une troupe), et je travaille également différentes voix et interprétations, depuis quelques années maintenant. 

L’idée n’est donc pas simplement de créer quelques dessins, mais de construire ensemble un personnage et un projet qui puisse évoluer dans le temps. 

💰Concernant la rémunération

Je préfère être totalement transparente là-dessus. 

Pour le moment, le projet étant encore au tout début de sa création, et commençant seulement à travailler, je n’ai malheureusement pas encore le budget nécessaire pour rémunérer une personne. 

L’objectif est cependant de faire évoluer progressivement le projet et, ainsi, rémunérer la/les personne.s participant au  projet lorsque la chaîne commencera à fonctionner.

Je cherche donc avant tout, pour cette première étape, quelqu’un qui aurait réellement envie de participer à la construction de Mr. Bob et son univers avec moi. 

Si tu es illustrateur.rice, animateur.rice, monteur.euse, ou même simplement quelqu’un qui pense pouvoir apporter quelque chose au projet, malgré cette contrainte de rémunération, n’hésite pas à me contacter en privé ! 

Je pourrais te présenter Mr. Bob plus en détails, te montrer le croquis et expliquer ce que j’ai en tête. 

Merci d’avoir lu jusqu’ici ! Cela me fait vraiment plaisir ❤️

(Par mesure de confidentialité, j’ai changé le nom du personnage, il vous sera dévoilé lors de la signature du contrat.)

**LONDON** Casting for
We're looking for 2 confident performers and 1 Presenter/Host. The actors will play suspects and the presenter will host the show across our story worlds. Prior acting experience necessary, stage presence, improvisation, and comfort performing to a live audience are a must.

What's involved:

• Interacting with guests in character before the show starts, including being photographed with guests

• Playing a suspect character across live show nights

• Staying in character during live audience Q&A

• Delivering scripted reveal/alibi lines with different variations per night

Schedule: Shows run from 7:00pm to 11:00pm, with performers needed for the full window.

We're launching our first show on 17th of October, with our next run of shows from late November onwards, hosting 2 to 4 events per month.

Pay: £100 per show.

We're looking for the following:

• White Male with Dark Hair - 30-40 (Mysterious, Shady Character)

• White Male bald 45-60s

• Female Presenter 25-40s

Interested? Send us a short intro, a photo, and any performance/acting experience (if you have it) to team@theenquirylondon.co.uk

🚨 WARSZAWA!!!! 🚨
Na plan serialu „Gliniarze” poszukuję 2 mężczyzn do statystowania w roli kiboli w barze! ⚽️🍻

📅 Termin: 12.10 (poniedziałek)

🕘 Godziny poranne – planowo około 2 godziny na planie

💰 Stawka: 200 zł, płatne gotówką po planie!

📩 Zgłoszenia proszę wysyłać na adres: casting@outsetfilms.pl

W zgłoszeniu proszę o:

* imię i nazwisko,

* wiek,

* wzrost,

* numer telefonu,

* aktualne zdjęcie twarzy i sylwetki.

Zapraszam do zgłoszeń! 🎬

items.text:
SUNDAY COMEDY NIGHT

Live comedy. Great people. A different show every week.

Every Sunday, Południk 2.0 hosts one of Warsaw's most international comedy nights. If the weather is on our side, we'll be on the patio. If not, we'll move indoors and the laughs continue.

Stand-up. Improv. New voices. Experienced comedians. One audience.

WHAT TO EXPECT

• Stand-up comedy
• Live improv
• International comedians
• New acts trying comedy for the first time
• Fresh material every week

THINK YOU'D LIKE TO TRY COMEDY?

Every week we reserve one open mic spot for a first-timer.

Just 5 minutes, one microphone, and a supportive audience.

SCHEDULE

19:30 — Doors open
20:00 — Show starts

LOCATION

Południk 2.0
Wilcza 25, Warsaw

TICKETS

https://fienta.com/2-0-comedy-show2-154404

Come with friends or come on your own.

You'll leave having laughed with people you hadn't met two hours earlier.

Hard to explain.
Hard to copy.
Harder to forget.

@impactwarsaw
@miguelatcomedy

impactwarsaw.com/events

Inner Circle
https://t.me/+xJpuxiG5Au8xMmZk

items.text:
Hallo zusammen,
ich suche nach neuen Einstiegsmöglichkeiten, Projekten oder Open Calls im Bereich **physisches Theater, Live-Performance, moderne Kunstaktionen** und freie/queere Szene als **textilfreier Performer**, Darsteller oder Komparse.

**Kurz zu mir:** Ich bringe außergewöhnlichen Mut für textilfreie Kunst sowie Extreme Body Art mit. Über zwei Jahrzehnte war ich regelmäßiger Teil einer der bekanntesten queeren Partyreihen Deutschlands („Irrenhouse“ in Berlin) und besitze umfassende Erfahrung mit durchgehenden, interaktiven Performances. Auch als erfahrenes Textilfreies Modell (vor allem für dynamische Posen/Wechselposen) stehe ich gerne zur Verfügung.

Da viele Castings in der freien Szene intern laufen, suche ich hier den direkten Weg zu Regisseuren, Choreografen und Kollektiven für Projekte im Raum Leipzig, Mitteldeutschland und Berlin.
* **Mein detailliertes Künstler-Portfolio** mit allen bisherigen Stationen und Interessen **ist direkt auf meinem Facebook-Profil verlinkt**! Schreibt mir bei Interesse auch gerne direkt eine private Nachricht (PN).

Habt ihr Tipps für aktuelle Projekte, Netzwerke oder konkrete Open Calls, bei denen Performer mit Körpererfahrung gesucht werden? Ich freue mich über jede Nachricht oder Empfehlung!

items.text:
Casting Call for a Short Film (updated with one more lead role)
Hi everyone! We are casting for an independent short film shooting in📍Bucharest, Romania in early November.

Genre: Psychological Drama / Crime Comedy

📃Synopsis:

The film follows two brothers who travel to Romania believing they are about to inherit a fortune from their supposedly dying aunt. A series of misunderstandings and increasingly disastrous decisions turns their inheritance trip into a chaotic night on the run.

🎭 TIM

Gender: male

Playing ages: late 30’s - mid 40’s

Language: English with a UK accent 

Tim is an older brother. Reserved and overwhelmed, he is going through a quiet midlife crisis and feels stuck in life. He works as a supermarket shelf stacker and desperately wants a sense of achievement and recognition.

Tim is more grounded and responsible but his patience is constantly tested by his younger brother’s behaviour. Beneath his frustration is a vulnerable man who loves his brother, is proud of him, and desperately wants a win of his own.

Looking for:

• Excellent English with a UK accent

• Strong screen presence

• Naturalistic acting and strong emotional range

• Ability to play restrained frustration and vulnerability

• Comfortable with fast dialogue & profanity

🎭 JOE

Gender: male

Playing ages: 20–30

Language: English with a UK accent 

Flamboyant, confident, funny and highly verbal. Joe is intelligent and successful, but underneath his confidence is an emotionally immature younger brother who desperately wants his older brother’s approval.

He uses humour as a defence mechanism, becoming more sarcastic, energetic and ridiculous when uncomfortable or afraid.

Looking for:

• Strong comic timing

• Excellent UK English

• Improvisational instincts

• Strong screen presence

• Comfortable with fast dialogue & profanity

• Ability to shift naturally between comedy, arrogance, fear and vulnerability

🎭 AUNTIE VIOLET

Gender: female

Playing ages: 65-75

Language: English with a UK accent 

A key supporting role with relatively short screen time, but an important presence in the film. 

Violet initially appears to be a wealthy, eccentric elderly woman whom the brothers believe is dying. 

She is glamorous, sharp, mischievous and intimidating, with a strong sense of control and authority.

Looking for:

• Strong comic timing

• Excellent UK English

• Confident, commanding presence

• Ability to convey glamour and authority

• Ability to play sudden, realistic death

• Comfortable with profanity

Note: The final head-explosion effect will be created using a dummy/prosthetic. The actress will not be in danger.

▪️Audition: Self-tape

▪️Only all expenses related to the project will be covered, including meals, travel.

📩 To apply: send your headshot + CV to cinedanny88@gmail.com

Please include “TIM”, “JOE” or  “AUNTIE VIOLET” in the subject line.

📢 Feel free to share this casting call with anyone you think might be a good fit for either role. Thank you

✨ CASTING CALL – CHRISTMAS 2026 | NORTH WALES ✨

After a smashing season last year, once again we invite you to step into the magic this Christmas! We’re casting a variety of performers and actors for Return of the Guardians, an immersive festive adventure at Reindeer Lodge, Leeswood, North Wales.

We’re looking for talented individuals for:
🎭 Interactive scripted & improvised immersive characters (limited positions available)
🎤 Performers for The Magic of Christmas live stage show (dance and/or musical theatre training desirable for actors)
📅 Contract Dates between : 20th November – 24th December 2026 (mainly Thursday to Sunday dates)
🎬 Rehearsals: 16th–19th November (Prestatyn)
📍 Location: Reindeer Lodge, Leeswood, North Wales (near Mold)
✨ Excellent rate of pay

Please note:
🏡 Accommodation is not provided, so this opportunity is best suited to performers who are based in North Wales or can arrange their own accommodation and travel for the contract period.

If you have a passion for creating unforgettable Christmas memories and love engaging with families through immersive storytelling, we’d love to hear from you.
📧 Send your CV and showreel to: reindeerlodgecasting@gmail.com

Come and help us bring the magic of Christmas to life! 🎄❄️

#castingcall #christmascasting #christmasperformance #performerswales #northwales

Szukamy osób o etnicznej urodzie w wieku 5-17 lat oraz osoby do poszukiwania takich osób do odgrywania scenek na nagrania w Gdańsku lub w Warszawie.

1. Czas nagrania - 1 godzina. Termin i godziny do uzgodnienia. Nagrania są od poniedziałku do piątku.

2. Lokalizacja: Warszawa lub Gdańsk.

3. Zależy nam na dużej różnorodności etnicznej dzieci.

4. Wynagrodzenie za udział dziecka: 300 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po zleceniu — BLIK/konto bankowe).

5. Szukamy pilnie również osoby do szukania takich dzieci o etnicznej urodzie. Wynagrodzenie za znalezienie takiego dziecka, które zostanie zaangażowane do projektu — do uzgodnienia. Prosimy o wiadomość na adres e-mail rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

W razie zainteresowania prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia dziecka, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy do rodzica

5. Adres e-mail do rodzica

6. Wzrost

7. Na jakie miasto jest wysyłane zgłoszenie dziecka? Na Gdańsk czy Warszawę? Czy na oba miasta?

8. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Nagrania-Scenki

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w projekcie zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

Du hast bereits Shootingerfahrungen gesammelt und nächste Woche Zeit? Dann melde dich bei uns! 🙌

Bei Alphatrail entwickeln wir hochwertige Fahrradhelme und Zubehör. Jetzt setzen wir unsere brandneuen Premiumfahrradhelme in München mit Fotos und Videos in Szene.

Wir stecken viel Leidenschaft in unsere Produkte. Diese Leidenschaft bringen wir auch ins Shooting ein, mit Liebe zum Detail und dem Anspruch, gemeinsam einen hochwertigen Dreh mit authentischen Bildern und Videos umzusetzen.

**Casting Call: 3 Actors for Security-Awareness Videos | Berlin**

We're looking for three Berlin-based actors for a series of 21 short security-awareness training videos for a large cybersecurity company.

**Who we're looking for:**
* Fluent English with a neutral American accent.
* A professional, approachable presence. Open to different ages and backgrounds.
* Natural, expressive delivery with personality - comfortable bringing curiosity, concern, surprise and urgency to educational content.
* We're aiming for a diverse cast, ideally two women and one man.

**Shoot details:**
* One full shoot day in Berlin, date TBC.
* Each actor will present several videos within the series.
* Paid project. Fee and usage terms to be agreed before booking.
* Content will be used for corporate security-awareness training and dubbed into approximately 40 languages.

To apply, please send your headshots, showreel or an English-language performance sample, availability in October, and your day rate. Shortlisted actors will be invited to submit a brief self-tape.

**Contact:** alena@representstudio.com or telegram @xvostikova

🎬 CASTING AVAILABILITY ENQUIRY – CAPTAIN INDIA 🎬

BENA Entertainment House is looking for Black/African male and female extras aged 25–55 for the film project Captain India, starring Kartik Aaryan.

📍 Location: Torquay, TQ1
📅 Shoot dates: 10th, 12th & 13th October 2026
🌙 10th October: Night shoot (10 PM – 10 AM)
☀️ 12th & 13th October: Day shoots
💰 Paid opportunity + night allowance
🚗 Travel and accommodation provided from Birmingham.

📩 HOW TO APPLY:
Please DM us or email benaentertainmenthouse@gmail.com with:
 1. Your most recent full-length solo photos.
 2. Your full name and contact number.
 3. Your travel plan (Birmingham pickup or self-drive).

⚠️ Please confirm your availability for the relevant dates when applying.

📢 Availability enquiry only – please apply if you fit the criteria and can commit to the shoot dates.

Thank you!
BENA Entertainment House 🎥

items.text:
We have a SHELL job we are casting for specifically on Thursday, 8th October 2026

Please see roles below:

JHB Asian Mom
JHB Asian Leo
JHB Asian Dad

Please have a close look at role descriptions, JHB Talent will need to self tape but if you have talent in CPT please state this under provisions and we will invite to studio.                                               
JHB Asian Mum
Description
__________________________
30- 40 yrs

Mum is the kind of parent who quietly helps fuel Leos imagination.
She gives him the freedom to explore, create and get lost in his own world, while always being there with warmth, encouragement and a playful spirit.
She has a natural way of making everyday moments feel special and brings a genuine sense of joy and creativity into Leos life.

Mum is a grounding force that brings a sense of warmth and comfort.

In casting, we need to get a sense of how our parents interact with children.
You can spot right away if the performer has that mum or dad energy with how they play, and how they redirect the kids on their own.
Gender
Female
Playing Age
30 to 40 years
Appearance
Asian
Rate
R10,000 day fee
View And Respond To This Role
JHB Asian Dad
Description
__________________________
30-40 yrs

Dad is the kind of parent who turns simple drives with Leo into something they both look forward to, whether it is heading out to a forested road or just around the
neighbourhood.

Their adventures often begin with a stop at a Shell forecourt, and Dad has quietly noticed how much Leo has absorbed from those moments, especially the Click. Shtick. Vroom. ritual he has created from the familiar sounds of filling up.

He has a calm, grounding presence that gives Leo the freedom to let his imagination run wild,
while still being right there with him, ready to tap into the kid in himself and share in the joy of the moment.
Dad shares his love of cars and always supports Leos curiosity and imagination.
